Alto Las Condes

Large and comfortable mall for planned shopping, families and those driving through the eastern area.

Best for

  • Families
  • Rainy day
  • Relaxed shopping

Not ideal for

  • Tourists relying only on metro

Getting there

Not the most direct metro option; best combined with taxi/Uber or car.

Recommended time: 2–4 hours
